guidance.statement: Remains on track to install 10,000 EV charging points in the near term

guidance.statement: Expecting around ₹1,500 crores of EBITDA in FY27.
Volume growth expected to continue in a similar manner; no revenue guidance given

industry: Energy > Oil, Gas & Consumable Fuels > Gas > LPG/CNG/PNG/LNG Supplier

operating_notes.text: Gas pool price for March 2026 was $12.42 per MMBtu.
Q1FY27 gas sourcing: domestic APM and NWG allocation about 40%, long-term contracts 48%, imported RLNG about 38% of portfolio, spot about 15% of total consumption after curtailment.

Pooled gas mechanism was withdrawn after the peace deal; industry-level representations are ongoing for its restart, with management expecting possible positive news shortly if Middle East tension persists.
Steel pipeline expanded to 15,987 inch-km; combined with IOAGPL, 53 geographical areas, 1,167 CNG stations and 13.74 lakh CNG households.
Mr. Sanjay Pandita appointed as Executive Director and CEO effective November 1, 2026, following the superannuation of Mr. Suresh P. Manglani.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,694.61 Cr (+16.6% YoY), net profit ₹168.34 Cr (+8.9% YoY).
TotalEnergies Holdings SAS, promoter of Adani Total Gas Limited, confirmed no encumbrance on shares during FY 2025–26, signed by Frederic Agnes, SVP Corporate & Project Finance, on March 31, 2026.
Adani Total Gas hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call discussing operational performance and gas pool pricing.
Shareholders approved Mr. Suresh P Manglani’s re-appointment as Executive Director via postal ballot with ~99.89% votes on May 6, 2026.
S.B. Adani Family Trust, on behalf of Adani Promoter Group, declared no new encumbrances on Adani Total Gas Limited shares for FY2026 beyond prior disclosures.
On its 22 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, Adani Total Gas reported revenue up 27% YoY to ₹1,908 Cr and EBITDA of ₹281 Cr, with volumes up 13% to 303 MMSCM and spot gas at about 15% of consumption.
Adani Total Gas reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹2,109.65 Cr and PAT of ₹173.27 Cr, and announced leadership changes with Mr. Sanjay Pandita taking over as CEO and Executive Director.
Adani Total Gas provided the audio recording link for its Q2FY27 earnings call held on October 23, 2026.

watchlist.response: Gas sourcing head said the portfolio is a mix of APM, non-APM, HPHT and RLNG contracts and deferred detailed discussion; later gave only that 85% of CNG volumes come from APM, HPHT and WG and about 16% is bought spot.

status_history.evidence: Sourcing mix given as domestic 62% and imported RLNG 38%, with spot at about 15% of total consumption after curtailment; no separate APM vs non-APM split.

watchlist.text: Analyst asked for the CNG gas sourcing mix (APM vs non-APM) and the Q4 sourcing mix

watchlist.response: CEO cited market-priced gas and declining APM allocation; gas sourcing head said margins improve once the Middle East crisis ends and US/Qatar supply arrives, but gave no date.
watchlist.text: Operating margin compressed from about 25% to 15% over six to eight quarters; when will it recover?

watchlist.response: Gas sourcing head pointed to mid-term and long-term purchases once prices stabilise; no quantified margin floor or timeline.
watchlist.text: How much of the margin pressure is cyclical versus structural, and what internal actions protect margins?

watchlist.response: CEO gave no revenue figure, saying only that volume growth will continue similarly and the challenge is to bridge the spot volume gap.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for appointment of Mr. Sanjay Pandita as Whole-time Director
